description: This Java class 'InterpolatorFragment' demonstrates the use of animation interpolators and path animations in Android Material Design. It manages UI components for selecting interpolators and animation durations, and performs scale animations on a view along predefined paths.

classes.name: InterpolatorFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that demonstrates animation interpolators and path animations, allowing user interaction to select interpolators and animation durations, and animating a view along specified paths.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes UI components, loads interpolators, and sets up animation paths and event listeners.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts an ObjectAnimator that scales a view along a path with specified interpolator and duration.

methods.name: getInterpolators
methods.description: Returns the array of loaded interpolators.

methods.name: getPathIn
methods.description: Returns the path used for the 'in' (shrinking) animation.

methods.name: getPathOut
methods.description: Returns the path used for the 'out' (growing) animation.
